tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog yum rkyang gi 'pho ba chig brgyud gser chos kyi gdams pa mal lo tsā'i gsung la rje sa chen gyis zin bris mdzad pa'i nyams len gyi snying po bzhugs// dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan spyir 'pho ba bsgom/ /rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i/ /lus nang dbu ma'i mas snar chos 'byung nang / /rang sems bam̐ yig spyi bor chos 'byung nang / /seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /bla ma mkha' spyod dbang mor gsal ba la/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams thim/ /phyi dang nang gis mchod cing bstod par bgyi/ /bla ma rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'chug med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang dbugs phyi la 'gro ba dang bstun nas/ /'og rlung 'then pas lte ba'i rang gi sems/ /bam̐ yig gsal ba de las de 'dra ba/ /gcig chad dbu ma'i nang brgyud spyi bo nas/ /rgyangs kyis thon nas bla ma rnal 'byor ma'i/ /lte bar zhugs nas thugs kha'i bam̐ la thim/ /rang dbugs nang 'jug dus su rang sems bam̐/ /mar la babs te dbu ma'i nang brgyud nas/ /sngar gyi lte ba'i bam̐ yig de la thim/ /spyi bo'i bla ma rnal 'byor ma de yang / /rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ yig thim par gyur/ /tshul 'di bsgoms pas rang gzhan mkha' spyod kyi/ /go 'phang thob nas don gnyis mthar phyin shog /las sbyor dus gong gi tshig lte bar zhugs nas thugs kha'i bam̐ la thim/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ bar do med par rdo rje rnal 'byor mar/ /gyur nas mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsam la rang sems bam̐ yig mar mi 'bebs pa yin/ zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dgas bris// //
